description: This file provides API functions for wizard configuration, onboarding, and status management in a web UI, including data transformation and mock data handling for development.

methods.name: getWizardInfo
methods.description: Fetches wizard configuration data, using mock data in development mode.

methods.name: submitWizardConfig
methods.description: Submits wizard configuration data to the server or mocks submission in development mode.

methods.name: startAgentOnboarding
methods.description: Initiates agent onboarding process via specified method ('wps' or 'ethernet').

methods.name: getAgentStatus
methods.description: Retrieves current status of the agent onboarding process, with mock data in development.

methods.name: completeAgentSetup
methods.description: Completes the agent setup process, with mock logging in development.
